review_notes: Read the whole file. It has no simp lemmas or attributes. The only simp-related thing it does is define the filter-based Finsets slotVertices and neighbors. I checked their uses in sibling Selection files. Users unfold the definitions by hand or destructure Finset.mem_filter by hand. A repository precedent defines @[simp] mem_neighbors for a similar neighbors Finset. I did not run Lean. I did not flag the other definitions (successMass, cylinderMass, outcomeWeight, and so on). I found no evidence of loops or competing rules for them, and recommending simp lemmas for them would be speculative.

findings.excerpt:
def slotVertices (G : Input I V) (i : I) : Finset V :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.slot v = i)
findings.problem: slotVertices and neighbors are filter-over-univ definitions with no canonical membership simp lemma. Downstream, membership goals are not normalized by simp. Proofs either unfold the definitions (`simpa only [Finset.card_univ, slotVertices]`) or destructure Finset.mem_filter and Finset.mem_univ by hand. Unfolding exposes the `Finset.univ.filter` representation instead of a stable normal form. Sibling files in the repository give analogous neighbors Finsets an `@[simp] mem_neighbors`, so this one is inconsistent.
findings.proposed_change: After the definitions, add `@[simp] theorem mem_slotVertices (G : Input I V) (i : I) (v : V) : v ∈ slotVertices G i ↔ G.slot v = i` and `@[simp] theorem mem_neighbors (G : Input I V) (v w : V) : w ∈ neighbors G v ↔ G.graph.Adj v w`. Each should be proved by `simp [slotVertices]` or `simp [neighbors]`. Both are non-looping, because the right-hand side no longer mentions the Finset. Then replace the manual `Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, _⟩` in SelectionPostcheckTail.lean with `by simpa using ...` or `simp`.
findings.benefit: Membership in slot classes and neighborhoods normalizes directly to `G.slot v = i` and `Adj v w` under simp. Proofs no longer unfold the definition or hand-destructure filter membership. The interface matches the repository's other `mem_neighbors` simp lemmas.
